tool_input.command:
gh api repos/o/r/issues/comments/1 --jq .body > "$TMPDIR/c.md" && python3 - "$TMPDIR/c.md" <<'EOF'
import sys, re
body = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
for m in re.finditer(r'#(\d+)', body):
    print(m.group(1), body[m.start() - 20:m.end() + 20])
open(sys.argv[1], 'w').write(body.replace('#5', 'GH-42'))
EOF
